title: Thani Oruvan
desc: Mithran, a police officer, pledges to reveal the lies and malpractices of Siddharth Abhimanyu, a renowned scientist, who uses illegal methods to make profit.

title: Madraskaaran
desc: Sathya, an engineer-turned-farmer, lives peacefully in Kovilpatti with his family. His life is disrupted when he is attacked by henchmen sent by his enemy, Singam.

title: Mega Crocodile
desc: A researcher is commissioned to search for a missing person on the Hell Island full of crocodiles but soon find themselves endangered when giant crocodiles begin threatening their lives.

title: The Warriorr
desc: Satya, a doctor, is brutally beaten and driven out of his city by Guru, a ruthless gangster. However, Satya returns two years later as a police officer to exact revenge on Guru.

title: Sethupathi
desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.
